subject: Case study: scheduling discovery interview with Novum Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Emily Jansen <emily.jansen@novumhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Case study: scheduling discovery interview with Novum Health

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for agreeing to participate in a short case study about your team’s work with Redwood Inference. Our goal is a 30–45 minute recorded conversation that covers your objectives, how you use the platform in production, measurable impact, and any lessons learned — purely to help other engineering teams understand the solution.

To be mindful of your time, proposed agenda (can be trimmed):
- 5m quick intros and context
- 10m business goals & deployment story
- 10m technical deep dive (routing, caching, quantization choices)
- 5–10m results/metrics (latency, cost, throughput)
- 5m publishing permissions and next steps

Would you be available for one of these slots next week (PT)?
- Wed Aug 20, 10:00–10:45am
- Wed Aug 20, 2:00–2:45pm
- Thu Aug 21, 11:00–11:45am

We typically record so we can accurately capture quotes; we’ll send a short consent form ahead of the call. Monica (CS) will join to cover operations questions. If Luke or a procurement contact should be on the call for approvals, let us know.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0178

---
From: Emily Jansen <emily.jansen@novumhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Luke Tan <luke.tan@novumhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Case study: scheduling discovery interview with Novum Health

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the note and the clear agenda. Happy to help. Wed Aug 20 at 2pm PT works for me. I’ll include Luke — he owns the deployment side — and I’ll loop in procurement for any final sign-off on publishing the case study.

Two quick asks from our side:
1) Can you pass along the short consent form and a list of the specific metrics/questions you’ll ask?
2) We prefer the recording to be used for transcription and internal review; for external publishing we need explicit approval on quotes and any screenshots that show PII-free telemetry.

If that works I’ll accept once I see the calendar invite.

Best,
Emily Jansen
Director, Data Platform | Novum Health
emily.jansen@novumhealth.com

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Emily Jansen <emily.jansen@novumhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Case study: scheduling discovery interview with Novum Health

Perfect — thanks Emily. I’m attaching a concise consent form and the interview question set so you have everything ahead of time (see attachments). Key points: we record for internal notes/transcription; we won’t publish any quotes or screenshots without your explicit sign-off; screenshots will be scrubbed for PII. If Novum needs a legal review, we’re happy to loop in our legal team.

I’ll send a calendar invite for Wed Aug 20, 2:00–2:30pm PT and set the meeting to 30 minutes; we can extend if needed. Monica will take notes and Rishi will monitor for any contract/promo entitlements to flag. Vivek is cc’d to surface the case study to our marketing leads once we have approvals.

Proposed calendar description (short): Case study interview: Novum Health x Redwood Inference. Recording consent requested; see attached consent form. Agenda: intros, deployment story, technical decisions, results, permissions.

Thanks again — invite incoming.

—Marissa

Attachments:
- redwood_case_questions.docx (docx)
- case_study_consent_form.pdf (pdf)

---
From: Luke Tan <luke.tan@novumhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Emily Jansen <emily.jansen@novumhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Aug 2025 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Case study: scheduling discovery interview with Novum Health

Thanks Marissa — 2pm PT on Aug 20 works for me. I reviewed the questions; two notes:
- We’ll avoid sharing raw latency traces that contain machine IDs or internal hostnames. We can provide aggregated percentile numbers and a sanitized chart instead.
- For publishing, Novum needs a short timeline to route quotes through comms (48 hours after draft).

I’ll accept the invite once it appears.

—Luke
Senior Engineering Manager | Novum Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Emily Jansen <emily.jansen@novumhealth.com>, Luke Tan <luke.tan@novumhealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2025 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: Case study interview — Wed Aug 20, 2:00–2:30pm PT (recording consent requested)

Calendar invite sent (Zoom) — link: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210

Short reminder and next steps:
- Please review the attached questions and the consent form ahead of the call.
- Monica will cover the operational questions; Rishi will note any contractual items.
- We will record the session for transcription. We will not publish any quotes or screenshots until Novum signs off on the draft; Novum requested 48h turnaround for approvals.
- Deliverables: interview transcript, 1–2 page case study draft, short quote pull for approval.

If legal from Novum wants to exchange edits to the consent PDF, I can route to our legal team (Vivek is cc’d). See Drive folder for materials: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bCaseStudyNovum

Thanks team — see you Wed at 2pm.

—Marissa
